label: nyiso 31 synch-commit [probe]
definition: REJECTED PROBE (keeper stays nyiso-27 cc-offer). Path B of the downstate synchronised-reserve fix: commitment-gated spinning reserve (MILP-free). The NYC 250 MW spinning family rides the ordinary class-1 (quick-start) headroom while the P2 commitment screen zeroes decommitted availability, so the row equals Sum_online(pmax - P) -- the physically-correct synchronised headroom -- and a new reserve_adequacy_commit force-commits NYC quick-start to the measured 250 MW requirement. RESULT: a true no-op -- every scored metric reproduces the keeper essentially exactly (C1 CT_PEAKER 2023 -1.30/2024 -1.51 TWh; C3c >$300 1/0/8 vs actual 10/12/42; C3a 2024 -9.7%), and P1==P2 prices. ROOT CAUSE: the committed NYC quick-start fleet holds ~1,700 MW of genuine online headroom in the tightest hours vs a 500 MW 10-min / 250 MW spin requirement, so the measured reserve requirement is NON-BINDING and no RCPF tail can form -- commitment removes only offline pmax, not the dominant committed-but-backed-off headroom. Both path A (nyiso-29 online proxy) and path B are thus confirmed insufficient with grounded inputs; the >$300 downstate tail stays an accepted, ledgered open frontier on nyiso-27 (closing it would need an ungrounded requirement/adder, forbidden by rule #12). Wiring kept as a NYISO-only default-off scaffold; implementation in the bundle model_changes.diff.
